title: Hearty American Porcini Paella
description: A sweet and light American twist on the classic paella dish, featuring marinated porcini mushrooms and a blend of flexitarian-friendly ingredients, cooked to perfection in a large paella pan. This show-stopping dish is sure to impress your guests.

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.notes: boneless, skinless, cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper to create a marinade.
Add the sliced porcini mushrooms to the marinade and toss to coat, letting it sit for at least 30 minutes.
Heat the paella pan over medium-high heat and add the marinated mushrooms, cooking until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the chicken breast to the paella pan and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the artichoke hearts, vegetable broth, saffron threads, and lemon juice to the paella pan, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and let cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender.
Remove the paella pan from the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the Hearty American Porcini Paella hot, garnished with fresh herbs and lemon wedges.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
